name: The Mountain Pass
descriptionSeed: The Mountain Pass — where the valley stops being a valley. Ten days up from Millbrook along the rising floor, three past Archive Hollow, the ground levels into a long stone shelf and then simply ends: the far lip, and beyond it the land going down and outward for as far as anyone has walked it. There is no gate and no wall. There is a cairn somebody built recently and a wind that comes up the descent instead of down it. Nobody in living memory had been this far and found it open. It is open now.
encounterFlavor: people who came up to look and have not gone back down; a Millbrook survey party arguing about whether to report it; whoever left the boot prints, possibly, coming the other way
questSeeds: The boot prints on the far side are not from any tread made in the valley
Millbrook cannot decide whether to hold the pass, map it, or close it again — and one faction has stopped attending the meetings
Somebody has been leaving provisions at the cairn, and they are not for anyone going out
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180). `space_time` +0.35 is the highest component and it is the point: a pass is a place that is only about where it leads.
worldPosNote: SNG-540: MINTED AT THE FAR LIP OF THE VALLEY PLATEAU, chosen from the terrain rather than picked. Walking straight outward from Millbrook along lon 251.895 the river valley climbs 149 -> 168 and then holds a shelf from lat -65.95 to -63.70 before descending steadily to +21 over the next 170 miles. This is the outer edge of that shelf: elevation 168 (+40 above a sea level of 128), biome `river_valley`, 156 mi / 10 walking days from Millbrook and 47 mi / 3 days past Archive Hollow, which sits on the shelf itself. Region vote: `valley` at 3.06e-2, two orders above the next — a pass out of the valley is still valley ground, which is what a threshold is. TIER/ROLE: authored as tier `settlement` + role `gate`, NOT a `site`. SNG-398 requires a site to sit within ONE DAY of its parent, and this is 3 days past Archive Hollow and 10 past Millbrook — which is the whole point of a pass. `gate` is the ratified role for a threshold, so no vocabulary was invented for it.
